# ZensCars Newquay

> Private hire taxi and chauffeur operator based in Newquay, Cornwall, UK. Owner-operated by Wayne since 2019. Tagline: "Private hire with dash".

Contact: 07376 299060 (call or WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447376299060)
Base: Newquay, Cornwall, England

## Services
- [Airport Transfers](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/airport-transfers/): Cornwall Airport Newquay pickups and drop-offs, flight-tracked so a late landing never means a missed ride.
- [Train Station Transfers](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/train-station-transfers/): Newquay rail station pickups and connections onward to Par, Truro and the mainline - timed to your train, not a rough estimate.
- [Weddings & Parties](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/weddings-parties/): Smart, unhurried transport for wedding parties and nights out - dressed for the occasion, never rushing you.
- [School Contracts](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/school-contracts/): Dependable daily school runs for families and education providers who need the same trusted driver, every time.
- [Hospital & Clinic Runs](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/hospital-clinic-transport/): Patient transport to Royal Cornwall Hospital (Treliske) and local clinics - door to door, with time for those who need it.
- [VIP & Chauffeur](https://zenscars.co.uk/services/vip-chauffeur/): Discreet, professional chauffeur service for business travel, VIP guests, and anyone who wants it done properly.

## Areas covered
- [Truro](https://zenscars.co.uk/areas/truro/): 12 miles, around 20 min from Newquay. Cornwall's city - courts, county offices, shopping and Royal Cornwall Hospital (Treliske) all covered from Newquay.
- [Padstow](https://zenscars.co.uk/areas/padstow/): 17 miles, around 30 min from Newquay. Harbour-side dining and the Camel Trail - a relaxed private hire alternative to driving and parking in Padstow.
- [Wadebridge](https://zenscars.co.uk/areas/wadebridge/): 16 miles, around 28 min from Newquay. A straightforward run to Wadebridge for the Camel Trail, shops and connections onward.
- [St Austell](https://zenscars.co.uk/areas/st-austell/): 16 miles, around 28 min from Newquay. Private hire to St Austell for the Eden Project, rail connections and local business travel.
- [Perranporth](https://zenscars.co.uk/areas/perranporth/): 8 miles, around 15 min from Newquay. The closest coastal run on the books - Perranporth's beach, bars and Watering Hole in about 15 minutes.
